span.p:
SET v [d]
pin ← v
takes 1 + d cycles

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
WAIT n [d]
pin unchanged
takes n + d cycles

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
LOAD v [d]
shift_reg ← v
pin unchanged
takes 1 + d cycles

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SHIFT_OUT [d]
pin ← shift_reg[0]
shift_reg ← shift_reg >> 1
(same edge, then hold)
takes 1 + d cycles
